metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; apply downward bias correction for first 5–7 days.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >50.0), model tends to overshoot and fail to correct quickly; reduce forecast peak by 5–10% and add lagged mean reversion term.
- When sentiment history is flat (all 0.00), model exhibits high variance and overconfidence; cap forecast range within ±3σ of recent 7-day moving average.
- True outcomes often show strong mean reversion toward 48–52 range after 10–15 day spikes; model fails to reflect this; add 10–15 day exponential decay filter to forecast.
- If true outcome shows sudden drop after spike, model fails to anticipate; add penalty for “post-spike volatility” in forecast, especially if sentiment remains neutral.
- For 30-day horizon, model overfits recent trends; reduce weight of last 3–5 days in forecast composition; use 18-day rolling average as anchor.
